intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Gurugram region of Haryana. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

Amity University Haryana vs The NorthCap University is a same-region private comparison. Amity Haryana has a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 101 on this page. NCU's latest NIRF Engineering row here is from 2022, at 96.

sections.heading: Amity University Haryana vs The NorthCap University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: The NIRF Engineering ranks are close in number but not from the same year. Amity Haryana is ranked 101 in 2025. NCU was ranked 96 in 2022, and we do not have a 2025 Engineering rank for NCU on this page.
On 2023 placements, the recorded averages match at ₹5 lakh. Amity Haryana has the higher recorded highest package, at ₹45 lakh, against NCU's ₹31 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Amity University Haryana's recorded B.Tech tuition on this page is ₹2.34 lakh and ₹2.66 lakh a year, depending on the programme. There is no single Total Fees programme-total row in our records.

The NorthCap University has a recorded year-wise total of ₹2.46 lakh. The two sides sit in a similar private-university fee band. Confirm the official circular for your branch and batch before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year on this page, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Amity University Haryana's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹5 lakh and a highest package of ₹45 lakh. NCU's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹31 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both universities list JEE Main on this page. Amity and NCU also run their own admission processes for many programmes.
Class 12 PCM is the usual academic requirement. Read the current official admissions page of each university for tests, scholarships and counselling dates.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in the Gurugram region of Haryana, in the Delhi NCR belt. Amity University Haryana is at Manesar. The NorthCap University is in Gurugram.
If you already plan to stay in this belt, visit both campuses and compare the commute, hostel and labs, not just the university brand.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank, Amity University Haryana is the side that has one here, at 101. NCU's last Engineering rank on this page is from 2022.
If 2023 averages are your filter, the two sides are level at ₹5 lakh in our records. Amity Haryana has the higher recorded highest package that year.
Fees are similar in our records. Use each official fee notice for the exact programme you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity University Haryana or The NorthCap University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Amity Haryana has a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 101. NCU's latest Engineering rank here is 96 from 2022. Their recorded 2023 averages are both ₹5 lakh; Amity Haryana has the higher recorded highest package, at ₹45 lakh against ₹31 lakh.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for Amity Haryana vs NCU?
